summary: Germany (DE) localization of Business Central 29. It covers ELSTER sales VAT advance notifications, VAT-VIES/EU Sales List reporting, GoBD/GDPdU digital audit exports, Intrastat XML, delivery reminders, physical inventory orders, BilMoG exchange rate adjustment and XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Peppol e-invoicing.
overview:
The German layer reworks VAT reporting. Sales VAT advance notifications (ELSTER) are handled by own tables, pages and codeunits such as "Elster Management", and the VAT-VIES declaration and EU Sales List are handled through extended VAT Report tables, codeunits and reports. Learn describes these as two separate mechanisms that replace the generic VAT Report page. Company Information gains tax office, agency and registration fields, and corrections are supported by correction line fields and procedures on the VAT report objects.

Other own functionality includes the digital audit export (Data Export tables, pages and Export Business Data report), Intrastat report extensions with IDEV and eSTATISTIK.CORE channels, delivery reminders for vendors (headers, lines, issuing codeunits, setup pages, report selection), and physical inventory orders and recordings. The Foundation, Finance and Inventory areas also change W1 objects such as Document-Print, Format Address, Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch and the exchange rate adjustment (BilMoG valuation).

Electronic invoicing is built on the E-Document framework with XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol BIS 3.0 DE formats, plus PEPPOL30 DE codeunits. Learn documents the features under "Germany local functionality" and in separate pages for VAT, Intrastat, delivery reminders, digital audits and e-invoicing.
key_points: ELSTER sales VAT advance notifications: own table, card and list pages, setup, XML file creation report, and permission set extensions for the ELSTER VAT localization.
VAT-VIES declaration and EU Sales List: extended VAT Report Header, Line and Setup, ELMA5 XML export, correction lines and Suggest Lines.
Digital audit (GoBD/GDPdU): Data Exports, record definitions, sources and relations pages, with Export Business Data producing a ZIP with XML index.
Intrastat: German report extensions, place of dispatcher and receiver tables, submission channel enum for IDEV and eSTATISTIK.CORE.
Delivery reminders for vendors: terms, levels, text, create, issue and test report, with a Delivery Reminder code on the vendor.
BilMoG valuation method in exchange rate adjustment, via new parameters on Exch. Rate Adjmt. Parameters.
E-invoicing: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol BIS 3.0 DE export and import with buyer reference handling.
Negative entries via the Correction field in general journals, and vendor payments list and total-balance reports.

areas.what: Adds German VAT reporting: extended VAT Report tables (header, line, setup) with VIES/ELMA fields, correction handling, export procedures and an XML VIES codeunit. Adds the digital audit Data Export objects, German VAT statement, VIES and total-balance reports. Changes exchange rate adjustment with BilMoG valuation and adds a check hook in Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch.
areas.why: Learn explains that German VAT uses sales VAT advance notifications for ELSTER and VAT-VIES declarations for the EU Sales List. The BilMoG method treats short-term and long-term payables and receivables differently at year-end.

areas.what: Adds the delivery reminder feature: header, line and issued tables, create and issue codeunits and reports, list and card pages, terms, levels and text. Extends vendor, purchase setup and purchase order pages, and adds archiving options and registration numbers on purchase documents.
areas.why: Learn describes delivery reminders as a way to remind vendors of late deliveries, with setup of terms, levels, text and vendor codes.

areas.what: Adds German e-document support for XRechnung, ZUGFeRD and Peppol BIS 3.0 DE through the E-Document framework: format and handler codeunits, import and export, enum extensions, and page and report extensions on sales and service documents. Includes buyer reference handling.
areas.why: Learn states that XRechnung, Peppol BIS 3 and ZUGFeRD are supported, with a Buyer Reference Mandatory setting.

areas.what: Adds Intrastat report extensions for Germany (place of dispatcher and receiver, filter codeunits, submission channel enum) and a set of physical inventory order and recording tables. Adds item ABC analysis and inventory value reports.
areas.why: Learn says Intrastat reports are exported as XML through IDEV or eSTATISTIK.CORE channels.

areas.what: Holds the ELSTER objects: sales VAT advance notification table, card and list, electronic VAT declaration setup and overview, XML creation report and Elster management codeunits. Also holds upgrade plumbing and permission set extensions.
areas.why: Learn describes generating an XML file with tax data for the ELSTER portal through the ELSTER VAT Localization for Germany extension.

areas.what: Extends Company Information with tax office, agency and registration fields. Adds DACH report selections, the Delivery Reminder source code, Document-Print and Format Address procedures, and a Navigate event.
areas.why: Learn says tax office information on Company Information is needed for VAT reports and that registration numbers print on sales and purchase reports.

areas.what: Adds PEPPOL 3.0 German codeunits for sales and service validation, document and party info, context and subscribers, plus a format enum extension.
Adds fields on Fixed Asset (BWR depreciation book code, premium depreciation), changes depreciation book tables, and adds German book value and Austrian list reports.
Extends the LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets and adds delivery reminder permission set extensions.
Changes the Export Contact and Export Segment Contact XML ports.
Adds the Customer Total-Balance report and changes the Sales Line Archive table.
Adds a German expense event subscriber codeunit.
Adds a DACH extension of the Manufacturing Manager role center.
Changes the Service - Credit Memo report with document caption and number label procedures.

issues: 'Registration fields' on Company Information is loose. The fields added there are Company No., Sales/Purch. Authorized No., Agency No. and the Tax Office fields; a field named 'Registration No.' is only added to Vendor, Vendor Templ. and purchase documents. Learn does place the company registration number on the Tax Office FastTab, so the claim is acceptable.

The overview correctly reports that Learn says the two German VAT mechanisms replace the generic VAT Report page. However, the code still changes the W1 VAT Report, VAT Report Subform and VAT Report List pages. This conflict comes from the input, not from the narrative.

Minor gaps in coverage: fixed asset changes (Fixed Asset fields, Fixed Asset - Book Value 03), Archiving fields on Purchases & Payables Setup, the Elec. VAT Decl. Setup and Certificate tables, and objects with AT or DACH names (Update VAT-AT, Fixed Assets - List AT, DACH Report Selections) are not mentioned. Nothing stated is wrong.
